limits: Checks that a red GitHub Actions run on a commit surfaces as FLOW_CI_STATUS: failure under --strict-event, through a stub gh handed in by FLOW_CI_GH: a failure or cancellation listed AFTER a green run on the same event, and a pull_request-only red under required contexts that name no Woodpecker lane (test,lint). Good cases: all green, green plus skipped, and pull_request-only greens under the same non-Woodpecker contexts. Every run view call fails, so step naming, the precode/canceled origins, the all-skipped unknown verdict and the stall check are NOT covered here - tests/test_flow_ci_status.py covers those. Anchor is the gate at 626a96d9, before #1604; no network was used. A gate regressing to not-found under non-Woodpecker contexts is caught by bad-required-nonwoodpecker, not by the good cases: the good_signal accepts not-found because the anchor answers it there, and good/anchor agreement is required.
